description: Seventh review, N1 (Codex exec, minimal reproduction): `npm test` fails in the repository; then `bash -c 'cd OTHER && (true; cd REPO; true); npm test'` passes. The subshell's `cd` does not outlive it, so the second run is in the other checkout. Outside the closed grammar of a run: unplaced, its result unknown: WARN, never PASS.
